_comment: Shared vectors for how tall a Dock bar is.
Read by coui_core (the closed form of the sizing rule), coui_flutter (the rendered Dock) and a
real-Chrome probe of the Web markup, so a change on one platform fails the other.
Heights are logical px on Flutter and CSS px on the Web, at text scale 1 and a 16px root.
The rule: the bar is as tall as its item row asks, and never shorter than the minimum
CoreDockStyle.height states for its size. The row asks for the tallest item, plus the room the
bar keeps above and below it on both edges (CoreDockStyle.rowInsetFor: the larger of the
bar's padding side and the active plate's reach), plus the line around the bar on both edges.
Inputs: size (a CoreDockSize name); iconSize (the icon of every item, in px - no item has a
label, so an item is exactly as tall as its icon and no number here depends on a font);
padding ({top, bottom} in px), absent where the bar keeps its size's padding;
indicatorPadding ({top, bottom} in px), absent where the plate keeps its size's reach.
Expected: bar, the height of the bar's own box in px.
The first item is the active one: the room kept for the plate does not depend on which item is
selected, so the bar does not change height when the selection moves.

cases.name: xs: a 20px icon fits, the bar is the minimum
sm: a 22px icon fits, the bar is the minimum
md: a 24px icon fits, the bar is the minimum
lg: a 28px icon fits, the bar is the minimum
xl: a 32px icon fits, the bar is the minimum
md: a 42px icon asks for exactly the minimum (42 + 20 + 2)
md: a 43px icon asks for one px more (43 + 20 + 2)
md: a 60px icon, the bar grows to 82
xs: a 60px icon, the content sets the bar and not the size's own minimum (60 + 12 + 2)
xs: a 34px icon asks for exactly the minimum (34 + 12 + 2)
lg: a 50px icon asks for exactly the minimum (50 + 20 + 2)
lg: a 64px icon, the bar grows to 86
xl: a 70px icon, the bar grows to 92
md: a plate reaching 4 above and 12 below keeps the larger side clear on both (40 + 24 + 2)
md: a plate reaching 12 above and 4 below asks the same - the larger side again
md: a plate reaching 4, under the bar's padding of 10 - the padding is the room (43 + 20 + 2)
md: a plate with no reach - the padding alone, a 60px icon (60 + 20 + 2)
md: no padding above and below - the plate's reach of 5 is the room (60 + 10 + 2)
md: no padding, a 52px icon fits on the plate's room alone (52 + 10 + 2)
md: no padding and no reach - the line alone (70 + 2)
